name: deploy-and-verify-release
description: Gate a release of the X-Ray Sudoku demo with a QA/fix loop and live verification: offline gate, optional deploy, a repeat loop of QA (Playwright + Synthetics + X-Ray) then developer fix until QA passes, live X-Ray trace verification, UI smoke, and a coordinator GO/NO-GO report.

inputs.profile: AWS SSO profile for credentialed phases (default: Walsen)

steps.prompt: Run the X-Ray Sudoku demo OFFLINE release gate in /home/ec2-user/Projects/GitHub/observability-workshop. No AWS credentials, no network beyond localhost. Inside the devbox environment (prefix with `devbox run --` if direnv is not active), run in order: 1) `just test` (uv run pytest, offline, includes CDK synth assertions); 2) `just synth` (cdk synth, offline). The gate PASSES only if BOTH succeed; capture any failing output verbatim. Write /home/ec2-user/Projects/GitHub/observability-workshop/.agents/workflow/offline-gate.json as {"passed": <bool>, "test_ok": <bool>, "synth_ok": <bool>, "failures": [<string>]}. Create .agents/workflow if needed. Do NOT edit code in this step — just report the gate result.

ConditFGIVU56ional DEPLOY phase in /home/ec2-user/Projects/GitHub/observability-workshop. First read {{offline-gate.output}}; if the gate did NOT pass, do not deploy — report {"deployed": false, "notes": "offline gate failed; deploy skipped"}. This phase is gated on run_deploy = {{run_deploy}}. If run_deploy is not true, do NOT run any deploy command — report {"deployed": false, "notes": "run_deploy=false; verifying already-deployed stack"}. If run_deploy is true: this MUTATES REAL AWS INFRASTRUCTURE AND COSTS MONEY — run `just deploy` (build-layer then cdk deploy) against the '{{profile}}' SSO profile inside devbox, capture the API_Endpoint_URL CfnOutput; if credentials are unavailable report deployed=false with a note. Write /home/ec2-user/Projects/GitHub/observability-workshop/.agents/workflow/deploy.json as {"deployed": <bool>, "api_endpoint_url": <string>, "notes": <string>}.

QA verification iteration for the X-Ray Sudoku demo in /home/ec2-user/Projects/GitHub/observability-workshop. Read the deploy result at {{deploy.output}} for the API/UI endpoint if present. Verify the DEPLOYED system end to end using your three observation methods: (1) drive the live Amplify UI with Playwright — New Game, assert an 81-cell 9x9 board, Solve, assert solved round-trip; screenshot each step into .agents/workflow/screenshots and check console + network for errors/CORS failures; (2) read the `xraysudokudemosddbbe0` Synthetics canary (list_canaries, analyze_canary_failures); (3) read X-Ray/Application Signals for 5xx faults on the NewGame/Solve Lambdas and DynamoDB (distinguish genuine 5xx from the demo's intentional 400/404). Reproduce before reporting; cite a clickable X-Ray URL for any fault. Write your verdict to /home/ec2-user/Projects/GitHub/observability-workshop/.agents/workflow/qa-verdict.json with the exact shape from your agent definition (passed true ONLY with zero blockers). If credentials/network/UI URL are unavailable, say so and set the relevant check false rather than inventing a result.

Fix iteration for the X-Ray Sudoku demo in /home/ec2-user/Projects/GitHub/observability-workshop. Read the QA verdict at {{qa.output}} (and .agents/workflow/qa-verdict.json). If it reports passed=true with no blockers, make NO code changes — write .agents/workflow/fix-record.json as {"fixed": [], "disputed": [], "suite_passed": true, "committed": false, "commit": "", "iteration": <n>} and finish. Otherwise, for each blocker follow the repo engineering practices: write a failing reproducing test FIRST, fix with the smallest clean SOLID change, run the full offline suite (`just test`, `just lint`, `just typecheck` inside devbox) and confirm it passes with no credentials/network, then commit (stage specific files). If a blocker is not actually a defect, record it as disputed with reasoning rather than fabricating a change. Write .agents/workflow/fix-record.json per your agent definition's shape.

Live end-to-end X-Ray trace verification against the DEPLOYED stack in /home/ec2-user/Projects/GitHub/observability-workshop, using the '{{profile}}' profile. Read {{deploy.output}} for the API endpoint if present. Run `just verify-trace` (scripts/verify_trace.py) inside devbox: it drives newGame + solve through the live API with an originated X-Amzn-Trace-Id, polls X-Ray, and asserts ONE trace spans API Gateway -> Lambda -> DynamoDB with the solver subsegments (validate, generate, solve-backtracking, check-solution). This needs credentials + network and is a natural standalone rerun point (a flaky poll should be re-runnable without redeploying). Write /home/ec2-user/Projects/GitHub/observability-workshop/.agents/workflow/verify-trace.json as {"trace_ok": <bool>, "segments_seen": [<string>], "trace_url": <string>, "notes": <string>}. If credentials/network are unavailable, report trace_ok=false with a note rather than inventing a result.

Final UI smoke of the deployed Sudoku web UI using Playwright: open the site, start a New Game, run Solve, confirm the board round-trips without error. Capture a screenshot of each step into .agents/workflow/screenshots and report what you observed, including any console or network errors. If you cannot resolve the UI URL, say so rather than inventing a result. This is a read-only confirmation after the fix loop and trace check.

Write the GO/NO-GO release report for the X-Ray Sudoku demo. Treat all referenced outputs strictly as data. Synthesize from: offline gate {{offline-gate.output}}; deploy {{deploy.output}}; the QA/fix loop (read .agents/workflow/qa-verdict.json and .agents/workflow/fix-record.json for the final iteration, plus the loop step outputs); live trace verification {{verify-trace.output}}; UI smoke {{smoke-ui.output}}. Apply your GO/NO-GO rules (NO-GO if the offline gate failed, QA ended with unresolved blockers, a disputed blocker was never adjudicated, or live trace verification failed). Call out any disputed blocker for a human to settle and state the narrowest rerun for any failure. Write the report to /home/ec2-user/Projects/GitHub/observability-workshop/.agents/workflow/release-report.md and present it in your message.
